summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, attaching a press release announcing routine quarterly dividends. The Board declared a common share dividend of CAD $1.71 per share for Q4 FY2026, unchanged from the prior quarter, along with preferred share dividends for Series 44, 50, and 52. Payment and record dates are in late October and November 2026. A dividend reinvestment plan is available with open-market purchases and no discount. This is a standard dividend declaration with no special-situation elements, deal terms, or strategic actions.
